subject: NovaRetail MAP — final go/no-go, signing cadence, and start-week
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Sara Patel <sara.patel@novaretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: NovaRetail MAP — final go/no-go, signing cadence, and start-week

Sara — attaching an updated MAP and the SOW draft (v3). We're in the last mile and want to lock the go/no-go cadence and the signature windows so your onboarding team can pick a firm first-week slot. High level: 

- Proposed signature window: Aug 10 (esign sent Aug 10 morning, expected sign by EOD Aug 11)
- Canary start (limited capacity): week of Aug 17
- Full ramp / production start: week of Aug 24

Outstanding items we need from NovaRetail to hit the above: 
1) Legal redline confirmation (happy to accept 1 set of commercial redlines; our counsel will handle the rest)
2) SOC 2 report + data handling contact (Procurement asked)
3) Final counter-signer name and email for DocuSign (buyer + CFO if required)

If you prefer to move the canary earlier/compress ramp we can try, but it will require procurement to commit to the signature window this week. Please confirm what works for you and whether ProcureCo needs any additional paperwork. 

Attachments: [NovaRetail-MAP-v3.pdf (pdf)], [NovaRetail-SOW-Draft.docx (docx)]

—Sean
Sean Gallagher
Senior Account Exec, Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0193

From: Sara Patel <sara.patel@novaretail.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@novaretail.com>, ProcureCo Legal <legal@procureco.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 13:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: NovaRetail MAP — final go/no-go, signing cadence, and start-week

Thanks, Sean — the MAP looks good. A few notes from procurement/legal and ops: 

- Procurement needs the SOC 2 Type II (most recent) and a data retention clause callout before we can sign. I copied ProcureCo to flag that.
- Our preferred signing window is Aug 12–13 rather than Aug 10 if that helps (we have a CFO offsite on Aug 11). Can you do Aug 12 morning for DocuSign?
- For start date: we prefer Aug 24 for full production but would accept a canary Aug 17 if the limited-scope onboarding is documented in the MAP (who has access, data partitioning, success criteria).

Also: can you confirm whether Redwood will provide an IP carve-out for any on-prem connectors? That is a short legal ask.

Sara
Sara Patel
Head of Product Ops, NovaRetail
sara.patel@novaretail.com | +1 212-555-0102

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 09:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: NovaRetail MAP — final go/no-go, signing cadence, and start-week

Sean / team — quick internal alignment and my recommended approach: 

1) Accept Aug 12 morning for DocuSign. We'll send an envelope Aug 12 09:00 PT and ask for EOD turnaround. If CFO is delayed we have a backup window Aug 13 midday.
2) Canary scope: document in MAP (I added a 1-page "canary checklist" to the MAP attachments) — limited to 2 dev seats, no external reporting, data partitioning enforced. Success criteria: 95% api success, latency within SLO, two sample production prompts validated.
3) Start date: keep Aug 24 as production go. Canary week is Aug 17 — ops team will be on-call Aug 17–21. 
4) Legal asks: IP carve-out is negotiable. Rishi, can we offer a narrow connector-exclusion clause and flag to legal for redline?

If signatures slide >48 hours we offer a 30-day credit (one-time) to preserve the ramp economics — mention that to the buyer if you need to smooth a decision. Lauren — please prepare a short exec note in case Tom (VP Ops) escalates timing.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: NovaRetail MAP — final go/no-go, signing cadence, and start-week

Sara / team — thanks for the quick turnaround. To summarize and lock next steps so everyone is aligned: 

- Go/no-go call: Tue Aug 9, 08:30 PT (30m). Goal: confirm legal redlines & final signer list. Calendar invite to follow.
- DocuSign: We'll send Aug 12 09:00 PT (per Marissa). Envelope ID will be shared via HubSpot and DocuSign link (see related_links).
- Canary: Aug 17 — ops on-call, limited scope documented in MAP (attached).
- Production full start: Aug 24 — subject to finalized SOC2 link and executed agreement.

If we do not have a signed agreement within 48 hours of sending the envelope we'll: 
- Hold the Aug 17 canary until we have EITHER (a) signed agreement OR (b) a mutually agreed written exception from procurement.
- Offer one-time 30-day credit if signature slips because of buyer scheduling (to keep economics intact).

Next actions: 
1) ProcureCo: confirm whether the SOC2 link can be provided pre-sign or immediately after countersign.
2) Sara/Tom: confirm signer name/email for DocuSign (we need the exact full name as it appears on ID).
3) Rishi: finalize the narrow connector carve and send the legal clean copy to ProcureCo.

I'll send the go/no-go invite now. If anyone needs the envelope earlier/later, call me — +1 415-555-0193.

Attachments: [NovaRetail-MAP-v3.pdf], [DocuSign-Draft-envelope.pdf]

—Sean
